messages:
inc-bot: INCIDENT: elevated p99 latency and error-rate on /v1/generate (cont-batch) — auto-created incident #INC-2135. Severity: P1. Affected region: us-west-2.

maya-oncall: noticed spikes ~2135006795. p95 ok but p99 jumps to 12s, backend GPU hosts >90% memory for kvcache. seen timeouts to upstream model. paging eng/infra.

ellie-eng: I'm on it — pulling runtime metrics. Suggesting kv cache eviction spike is correlated with a new config rollout (continuous-batching defaults) ~2135006700.

raj_sre: grabbing logs now. seeing thousands of small sequences being batched into enormous token batches; batch token counts > 50k in some requests. That plus max_batch_tokens set high is thrashing KV page cache.

maya-oncall: can we confirm config values?

ellie-eng: current prod templated config (from runtime-configs):
```
cont_batch:
  max_batch_tokens: 20000
  max_num_seqs: 32
  timeout_ms: 1200
  enable_kv_cache: true
```
These were unintentionally promoted from the staging template.

raj_sre: that explains blowup. max_num_seqs 32 + long sequences => huge memory working sets, eviction churn. evict rates spiking per host.

zane-support: customers are reporting elevated 5xxs and latency on chat flows, at least 3 enterprise customers (sales flagged). Anna is looping in CSMs.

anna-csm: FYI reached out to two affected customers. they see ~10-15% error rate on generate calls between 2135060000-2135062000. they'll appreciate ETA.

maya-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) roll config hotfix to reduce max_batch_tokens and max_num_seqs 2) temporarily disable KV cache for critical model pool to let memory stabilize 3) throttle high token requests at gateway. Any objections?

ellie-eng: agree. propose immediate values: max_batch_tokens=4000, max_num_seqs=8, timeout_ms=600. patch rollout to a single AZ first.

raj_sre: preparing a canary patch. I'm applying patch to us-west-2a now. command: `kubectl set env deploy/cont-batch-runtime CONT_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=4000 CONT_BATCH_MAX_SEQS=8`

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by raj_sre at 2135006952 — rollout started for cont-batch-runtime/us-west-2a.

maya-oncall: also enabling gateway throttles for requests with >1024 input tokens. patching routing rule now.

ellie-eng: canaries look good after patch; memory use on hosts down ~40% versus peak and eviction rate normalizing. p99 down from 12s -> 1.1s on canary slice.

zane-support: customers reporting improvement after 2135007200. still seeing intermittent errors but trending down.

raj_sre: rolling the config change to remaining AZs with staged rollout and 2-min pause between AZs.

deploy-bot: rollout completed for cont-batch-runtime/us-west-2 at 2135007356. all pods stable.

maya-oncall: after full rollout, KV eviction rate normalized and tail latency returned to baseline. throttles remain in place for high-token requests.

anna-csm: customers confirm services recovered. one asked for root cause and ETA for permanent fix.

ellie-eng: immediate root cause: a bad promotion of staging defaults set max_batch_tokens and max_num_seqs too high for prod workloads. That created pathological batch token growth and led to KV cache thrash + timeouts.

maya-oncall: interim mitigations performed: reduced batching window/limits, temporary gateway token throttles, canary config rollout, and temporary KV cache disable for the most impacted model pool (to reduce eviction churn).

raj_sre: followups (post-incident): 1) add CI/deploy guardrail that prevents promoting staging batching defaults > production thresholds 2) add runtime alert for sustained per-host eviction > 500/sec 3) add config-schema validation in infra pipeline 4) run load test to validate new defaults under typical prod token distribution.

ellie-eng: also propose adding a rollout-safe flag that requires an explicit opt-in to change max_batch_tokens or max_num_seqs above conservative thresholds.

maya-oncall: handing off to next oncall (ellie-eng) for postmortem and tracking. My shift ends in 10. If anything re-escalates ping @maya-oncall.

ellie-eng: accepting handoff. I'll own the postmortem and a targeted follow-up runbook for cont-batch guardrails.

maya-oncall: thanks team. I'll update incident ticket INC-2135 with mitigation timeline and customer messages.

inc-bot: INCIDENT #INC-2135 status -> mitigated. Severity downgraded to P2 at 2135007440. Postmortem owner: ellie-eng. Slack handoff recorded.

ellie-eng: notes for postmortem: include timeline, exact config diff, list of affected customers, and planned deploy pipeline validations. assigning action items in the ticket.

raj_sre: adding monitoring dashboards for combined metric: (batch_tokens_per_request * active_seq_count) per host — to catch future token storms earlier.

zane-support: I'll collect customer logs and error windows for the CSMs and attach to INC-2135.

anna-csm: closing loop with customers; they want a monthly update post-mortem. I'll schedule a 1:1.

maya-oncall: closing my handoff. good work everyone :thumbsup:.
